title: Polished with some rough edges
body: Very polished and ambitious for a new app, but the error recovery and onboarding could use another UX pass.

title: Great app - missing Herdr for Windows
body: Hi - great terminal so far and I can see myself getting lots of use for my homelab out of it. But I got stopped short during herdr onboarding as meshTerm says herdr doesn’t support windows which is no longer true; they have a native windows server now. Would be great if you could update so I can utilize herdr across all my devices. Would also be cool to see more options added to the agents tab - are more planned?
